newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-KORDA TO FACE BHUPATHI IN OPENING SINGLES.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-KORDA TO FACE BHUPATHI IN OPENING SINGLES.

text.p: Petr Korda will face India's number two Mahesh Bhupathi in the
opening singles of their Davis Cup world group, first-round tie
In the draw, held at the Pribram Sports Hall on Thursday,
Olympic bronze medallist Leander Paes was picked to play Czech
Jiri Novak in Friday's second singles.
Pavel Vizner will team up with Martin Damm to face Paes and
Bhupathi in the doubles on Saturday.
The Czechs are seeded fifth in the tournament following
their strong performance in 1996 when they reached the
semifinals where they lost to Sweden. India are unseeded.
The tie will be played on indoor clay courts in Pribram, 55
